name: @red-cup-engineering/oauth-services-section
description: Web-tier home for the exploded OAuth 2.0 authorization-server: dynamic client registration, PKCE authorization, code redemption, bearer-token validation, RFC 8414/9728 metadata, and principal-admission judgment, plus the vendored Google upstream-IdP protocol under google-oauth-services-section. Also carries OAuthError, the one RFC 6749 error class every atomic service in this section throws, so `instanceof` checks stay true across service boundaries.
